title: RSV Nuyina 南極研究船
summary: 以Nuyina南極科研與補給雙重用途，建立冷環境、貨載、實驗室與能源之間的邊界；使用虛構航次資料比較研究與後勤需求。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Nuyina’s Antarctic research and supply roles to link cold conditions, cargo, laboratories and energy, comparing science and logistics with a synthetic voyage. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 分列科研載荷與補給載荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate science payload and supplies: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分列科研載荷與補給載荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate science payload and supplies and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分列科研載荷與補給載荷：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate science payload and supplies: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是RSV Nuyina 南極研究船實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=550 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 563.75 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of RSV Nuyina Antarctic research vessel: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=550 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 563.75 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「分列科研載荷與補給載荷」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate science payload and supplies and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：分列科研載荷與補給載荷。在極地船甲板示意、補給貨物卡、冷熱負載與研究日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為563.75，改變後為620.125 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate science payload and supplies. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Polar deck diagram, supply-cargo cards, thermal loads and science log. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 563.75 changes to 620.125 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

steps.instruction: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是RSV Nuyina 南極研究船實際規格：新增質量m=110 t、ρ=1.025 t/m³、水線面積A=2000 m²。式 ΔT=Δm/(ρAw)，基準結果 0.053658537 m。條件：小變化、定水線面積與密度；不是港口吃水或裝載安全判定。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of RSV Nuyina Antarctic research vessel: Added mass m=110 t, ρ=1.025 t/m³, waterplane area A=2000 m². Formula ΔT=Δm/(ρAw) gives 0.053658537 m. Conditions: Small change at fixed waterplane area and density; not a port-draft or loading-safety determination.
steps.failure: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較裝卸前後平均吃水」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Separate mean, forward and aft draft, verify harbor-water density and compare added weight. Also check that Compare mean draft before and after unloading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較裝卸前後平均吃水。在極地船甲板示意、補給貨物卡、冷熱負載與研究日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加新增貨物質量10%，比較平均吃水增量，明示未計縱傾。 算式區的基準值為0.053658537，改變後為0.05902439 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare mean draft before and after unloading. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Polar deck diagram, supply-cargo cards, thermal loads and science log. Increase added cargo mass alone by 10%, compare mean-draft increment and explicitly exclude trim. Baseline 0.053658537 changes to 0.05902439 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
新增貨物不論放哪裡，艏艉吃水都增加同樣數值。
只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Added cargo causes equal forward and aft draft changes wherever it is placed.
Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution.
quiz.explanation: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較裝卸前後平均吃水」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Separate mean, forward and aft draft, verify harbor-water density and compare added weight. Also check that Compare mean draft before and after unloading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
